With locations in Bedford, Salem and Portsmouth, NH , we specialize in Botox, Dysport, dermal & lip fillers, body contouring, laser treatments, weight loss and advanced skin & wellness solutions —delivered in a luxury, medically guided setting. We believe confidence starts with how you feel about yourself—and our mission is to help you reveal your most natural, youthful, and radiant self, inside and out. ✅ Top-rated expertise in non-surgical aesthetic medicine ✅ Customized treatment plans for every face, body, and lifestyle ✅ Medical-grade products and FDA-cleared technology ✅ Serving Bedford, Salem, Manchester, Nashua, and all other surrounding towns including Northern Massachusetts BOOK FREE CONSULT SOLUTIONS FOR ALL BEAUTY CONCERNS Personalized Plans, Real Results At Ariya Aesthetics, no two treatment plans are the same. OUR MEDICAL DIRECTOR ZUBIN BATLIVALA, MD Dr. Zubin Batlivala is the President of the Medical Aesthetic Providers of NH, a non-profit organization for independent medical aesthetic providers in New Hampshire. He is a board certified physician in NH and MA. He is an advocate for patient safety and is committed to supporting the highest practice standards for all medical aesthetic providers. Besides being involved in the aesthetic world, his other areas of interest include Neurotoxin and dermal filler injections for aesthetic and medical needs, pain management, comprehensive inpatient and outpatient rehabilitation services, post-acute and long-term care medicine and more. We respectfully request at least 24 hours notice for cancellations. Please understand that when you forget or cancel your appointment without giving us enough notice, we miss the opportunity to fill that appointment time for our other clients on our waiting list. Our appointments are confirmed at least 24 hours in advance. Less than 24 hour notice and “NO SHOWS” for Botox, Hydrafacials, Laser treatments, esthetician services and some other services will be charged $50. Less than 24 hour notice and “NO SHOWS” for Coolsculpting, Cooltone, Dermal Fillers, Morpheus and some other services will be charged $100. REFUND/RETURN POLICY Please understand all sales are final. No refunds or returns will be accepted for our services, products and treatments. All procedures/services are elective treatments and results may vary per client. BOOKING FEE (Non Refundable) A non-refundable booking fee will be charged for some of our services such as Coolsculpting, Cooltone, Dermal Fillers, Botox and any other new client services. PRIVACY POLICY At Ariya Aesthetics, we value and respect your privacy. Information We Collect: Personal details (name, contact information, etc.) for appointment scheduling. Medical history and treatment preferences for personalized care. Payment information for billing purposes. How We Use Your Information: To provide safe, effective, and tailored treatments. To communicate appointment reminders and special offers (with your consent). To comply with legal and regulatory requirements. Data Protection: We implement strict security measures to safeguard your data against unauthorized access. Your information will never be shared with third parties without your explicit consent, except as required by law. Your Rights: You may access, update, or request deletion of your personal information at any time. For questions or concerns, please contact us at ariyamedspa@gmail.com .
